name: FUN_TRX_BATCHES
description: This table contains information about the intercompany transaction batches. The BATCH_NUMBER and INITIATOR_ID together form a unique key. An intercompany transaction batch can contain many transactions for multiple recipients.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the batch.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Number assigned to the intercompany batch.

columns.name: INITIATOR_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the provider organization.

columns.name: FROM_LE_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the provider legal entity.

columns.name: FROM_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the provider ledger.

columns.name: CONTROL_TOTAL
columns.description: Entered by the user as a placeholder to indicate the amount they would like the batch to add up to. It is not the total of all the transaction amounts in the batch.

columns.name: RUNNING_TOTAL_CR
columns.description: Sum of the credit amount for all transactions in the batch.

columns.name: RUNNING_TOTAL_DR
columns.description: Sum of the debit amount for all transactions in the batch.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the batch. Transactions in a batch must be in the same currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate to use if batch is not in the provider's base currency

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the intercompany batch

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Transaction type of this batch. All transactions in a batch must be of the same type.

columns.name: NOTE
columns.description: Comments entered by the provider intercompany organization.

columns.name: TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type of this batch. All transactions in a batch must be of the same type.

columns.name: TRX_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type code of this batch, all transactions in a batch must be of the same type.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of the intercompany batch.

columns.name: BATCH_DATE
columns.description: The date used for processing the intercompany batch.

columns.name: REJECT_ALLOW_FLAG
columns.description: Whether the transactions in this batch can be rejected.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_BATCH_ID
columns.description: If this batch is reversing another one, this is the unique identifier of the batch it is reversing.

columns.name: REVERSED_BATCH_ID
columns.description: For a reversed batch that has been reversed this is the unique identifier of the batch created to reverse it.

columns.name: FROM_RECURRING_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identify the initiator instance: Local or Remote. Currently not used.

columns.name: INITIATOR_SOURCE
columns.description: Identify the initiator instance: Local or Remote. Currently not used.
